Name: OCP RAS Message Registry
Description: This registry defines messages for RAS (Reliability, Availability, Serviceability) operations including CPER/CPAD workflows, error queue management, repair operations, and policy enforcement.

CorrectedMemoryError.Description: A corrected (ECC) memory error was detected and handled by hardware.
CorrectedMemoryError.Message: Corrected memory error on %1 at address %2.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the memory device where the error occurred.
The physical memory address where the error was detected.
CorrectedMemoryError.Resolution: Monitor error frequency. Consider PPR if threshold exceeded.

CorrectedPCIeError.Description: A corrected PCIe error was detected.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the PCIe device where the error occurred.
CorrectedPCIeError.Resolution: Monitor error frequency. Check device and slot.

DeferredError.Description: An error was recorded for deferred handling. The system continues operation but the error requires attention.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the component with the deferred error.
The reason or type of deferred error.
DeferredError.Resolution: Schedule maintenance window to address the error.

FatalError.Description: A fatal error requiring immediate attention. System operation may be compromised.
FatalError.Message: Fatal error on %1. Immediate action required.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the component with the fatal error.
FatalError.Resolution: Check diagnostic data. Component replacement may be required.

CPERRecordCreated.Description: A new CPER record was generated and stored.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the CPER record that was created.
The name of the queue where the record was stored.

CPERRecordAvailable.Description: A CPER record is ready for retrieval by an initiator.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the CPER record that is available.

CPERRecordRetrieved.Description: A CPER record was downloaded by an initiator.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the CPER record that was retrieved.
The identifier of the initiator that retrieved the record.

CPERRecordDeleted.Description: A CPER record was removed from the queue.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the CPER record that was deleted.
The name of the queue from which the record was deleted.

CPERQueueFull.Description: An error queue has reached capacity. New records may be dropped or older records overwritten.
CPERQueueFull.Message: Error queue %1 is full. Capacity: %2 records.
ArgLongDescriptions: The name of the queue that is full.
The maximum number of records the queue can hold.
CPERQueueFull.Resolution: Retrieve pending CPER records to free queue space.

CPADReceived.Description: A CPAD action request was received by the service.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the entity that submitted the CPAD.
The type of action requested in the CPAD.

CPADValidated.Description: A CPAD passed structural and format validation.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the CPAD that passed validation.

CPADValidationFailed.Description: A CPAD failed structural or format validation.
ArgLongDescriptions: The reason the CPAD failed validation.

CPADActionStarted.Description: The action requested in a CPAD has started execution.
ArgLongDescriptions: The type of action that started.
The endpoint where the action is being executed.

CPADActionCompleted.Description: The action requested in a CPAD completed successfully.
ArgLongDescriptions: The type of action that completed.

CPADActionFailed.Description: The action requested in a CPAD could not be completed.
ArgLongDescriptions: The type of action that failed.
The reason the action failed.
CPADActionFailed.Resolution: Check diagnostic data for failure details.

PPRInitiated.Description: A Post Package Repair operation was initiated.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the memory device being repaired.
PPRInitiated.Resolution: None. PPR will complete on next boot.

PPRCompleted.Description: A Post Package Repair operation completed successfully.
PPRCompleted.Message: PPR completed for memory device %1. Rows repaired: %2.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the memory device that was repaired.
The number of memory rows that were repaired.

SPPRInitiated.Description: A Soft Post Package Repair operation was initiated. Unlike hard PPR, this does not require a reboot.
SPPRInitiated.Message: Soft PPR initiated for memory device %1.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the memory device being repaired.

SPPRCompleted.Description: A Soft Post Package Repair operation completed.
SPPRCompleted.Message: Soft PPR completed for memory device %1.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the memory device that was repaired.

MemorySpared.Description: Memory sparing was activated to replace a failing memory region.
MemorySpared.Message: Memory sparing activated. Device %1 spared by %2.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the failed memory device.
The identifier of the spare memory device replacing it.

ComponentIsolated.Description: A faulty component was isolated from use to prevent further errors.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the component that was isolated.
The reason the component was isolated.

PolicyCheckPassed.Description: A CPAD action was approved by the policy engine.
PolicyCheckPassed.Message: Policy check passed for action %1 from creator %2.
ArgLongDescriptions: The type of action that was approved.
The identifier of the entity that requested the action.

PolicyCheckFailed.Description: A CPAD action was denied by the policy engine.
PolicyCheckFailed.Message: Policy check failed for action %1. Reason: %2.
ArgLongDescriptions: The type of action that was denied.
The reason the action was denied.
PolicyCheckFailed.Resolution: Verify creator authorization and action permissions.

UntrustedCreator.Description: A CPAD was received from a creator not in the trusted registry.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the untrusted creator.
UntrustedCreator.Resolution: Add creator to trusted registry if appropriate.

UnauthorizedPlatform.Description: The target platform is not authorized for the requested action.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the unauthorized platform.
The type of action that was requested.
UnauthorizedPlatform.Resolution: Verify platform authorization for the requested action.

PolicyOverride.Description: A manual override was applied to bypass policy restrictions.
PolicyOverride.Message: Policy override applied by %1 for action %2.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the authority that applied the override.
The type of action for which the override was applied.
PolicyOverride.Resolution: Document override justification per security policy.

EndpointRegistered.Description: A new RAS endpoint was registered with the service.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the endpoint that was registered.
The type of endpoint that was registered.

EndpointRemoved.Description: A RAS endpoint was removed from the service.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the endpoint that was removed.

EndpointUnresponsive.Description: A RAS endpoint is not responding to requests.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the unresponsive endpoint.

InitiatorConnected.Description: A RAS initiator established a session with the service.
ArgLongDescriptions: The identifier of the initiator that connected.
The type of initiator that connected.
The identifier of the initiator that disconnected.
